selection_rule: v3 = v2 splits + evidence-budget upgrade, informed by the v2 postmortem (3 rounds, 3 rejections; same-treatment train readings 42.9/61.9/38.1 at k=3 = 24pp swing; per-component gains in airline are superadditive per the tau2 ablation EM77.0/WM79.5/Full84.0 vs base 75.5, so single-round increments sit below a k=3 gate's detection band). Train v3 = v2's 7 (all 6 remaining FIXABLE-PROVEN + MIXED 32) + 4 EASY-BOTH margin tasks (22,30,40,42: bare 3/4, champion 4/4) added for lesion-sample breadth; the airline pool has NO unused improvable tasks (9 FIXABLE + 3 MIXED total, 4 of them held in dev for transfer evidence). Dev v3 = v2 dev unchanged (2 anchors + regression sentinels 31/35 + margins 2/16 + held-out same-family 21/23/24/33), preserving cross-campaign comparability. Budget upgrade: k=6 (halves the gate CI width; dev cell count 30->60), rounds 5, --provisional-accept ON (repair >= +4 cells and dev net >= 0 cells and regressions <= reg-cap lets a rejected candidate serve as next round's working base exactly once; committed lineage advances only on a strict accept measured against the committed best; frozen-set endgame settles).

fixed_budget.stop_rule: Complete every scheduled train trial; run the paired repair screen before spending the held-out dev gate.
